readme.note: Simulation demo: ctx.createPart() and ctx.createConnector(). 'Node Factory' has no incoming connectors — on its first tick it creates two new BusinessCapability parts in its OWN model (each wired to it with a new connector), plus a third BusinessCapability part in a DIFFERENT model ('Generated'), then guards itself with ctx.state so it only ever does this once. Step or Run Simulation, then check the Message Log (left sidebar) for what it created. None of the newly-created parts get a viewMember automatically — createPart/createConnector only touch the Part/Connector tables, not any view placement — so look for them via Catalogs > Parts, or the Simulation menu's Script Console: findParts({ model: 'Reference' }) / findParts({ model: 'Generated' }).

parts.label: Node Factory
